trial_court: Court of Civil Judge-02, Shahdara District at Karkardaoma Courts, Delhi (Civil Suit No: 1244/22)
case_name: Punjab And Sind Bank vs Pawan Kumar

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Punjab & Sind Bank, Through AR/Attorney Sh. Nafe Singh
parties.respondent_defendant: Sh. Pawan Kumar, S/o Late Jai Singh

facts_of_case: The bank filed a suit against the respondent for recovery of Rs.1,07,000/- along with pendente-lite and future interest @ 18% per annum. The respondent had earlier filed a civil suit against the bank for recovery of money.

legal_principles.principle: A person who has received an amount in error must take reasonable steps to rectify the situation.
legal_principles.held: However, due to some error, inadvertently, an amount of Rs.3,00,000/- got credited in the account of the Defendant.

legal_principles.principle: A defendant who has received an amount in error must not take advantage of the situation by filing a false suit.
legal_principles.held: The respondent, who is bound to refund the amount of Rs.1,07,000/- as stated above to the claimant bank, who is custodian of the public funds, in place of returning of said amount filed a false suit.

outcome.final_order: The court ordered the recovery of Rs.1,07,000/- along with pendente-lite and future interest @ 18% per annum from the respondent.

use_for_drafting: drafting a suit for recovery of debt
responding to a cheque bounce case
advocating for a public sector bank
